# Support

Questions about Leaftext are asked and answered in public, on this repository's **[Discussions](https://github.com/ryanallen/leaftext/discussions/categories/get-help)**. It is readable and searchable without an account, and a free GitHub account is all you need to post.

Inside the app, press **Get help** on the version line at the foot of the start screen — the screen with no document open. It opens that same page in your browser.

## Before you ask

Three things turn a question into an answer the first time:

- **The version.** It is the start screen's last line, beside **Get help**, and it is selectable so you can copy it.
- **Your platform.** macOS or Windows, and which version if you know it.
- **The kind of file**, and the smallest one that still shows the problem.

Then say what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. A screenshot helps.

**Don't paste your documents.** Leaftext never sends a file anywhere, and neither should you — the few lines that show the problem are enough.

## Already written down

[**Get help**](../docs/04-help.md) says what to include and what these pages already answer. The rest of the documentation is at [leaftext.com/docs](https://leaftext.com/docs): [installation](../docs/02-installation.md) and the first-launch warnings on both platforms, the [quickstart](../docs/03-quickstart.md), and a page for each part of the app.

## Issues

The [issue tracker](https://github.com/ryanallen/leaftext/issues) is open. Use it when you are sure something is broken and you can say how to make it happen again; use [Discussions](https://github.com/ryanallen/leaftext/discussions/categories/get-help) when you are not sure, which is most of the time.

Leaftext is free and made by one person. Some questions will go unanswered, and a clear one with a version and a small file is the one most likely to get a reply.
